summary.text: Jake Johnson is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 113 who has served since August 6, 2019, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.
The General Assembly lists his occupation as real estate and his district as covering parts of Henderson, McDowell, Polk and Rutherford counties.

paragraphs.text: Johnson assumed office in the North Carolina House on August 6, 2019.

According to Ballotpedia, he won the 2020 general election with 59.6 percent of the vote, ran unopposed in the 2022 general election, and won the 2024 general election with 66.7 percent over Democrat Michelle Antalec.
Johnson serves as a House Deputy Majority Whip and as vice chairman of the Appropriations Committee, according to the General Assembly.

He chairs the Appropriations Subcommittee on Capital and Information Technology, the House Select Committee on Oversight and Reform and the Oversight Committee, and he co-chairs the Joint Legislative Oversight Committee on Information Technology.
